notes.title: Major Update 3 : Improved Graphics & New Tutorial
notes.content:
[h1]🚀 What’s New in BUMP[/h1]

[h2]🛡️ Introducing the SHIELD System[/h2]
[list]
[*] A brand-new feature in BUMP! Your shield adds a strategic layer to gameplay. The less shield you have remaining, the stronger the bump force you endure when hit, and the longer your inputs are disabled. This creates a dangerous cycle where getting hit makes you more vulnerable, making every decision critical to your survival.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048077/7cbe669ac17654d7ba76852ca356c12f69c89172.png[/img]
[h2]🎓 Skill-Focused Tutorial[/h2]
[list]
[*]     We’ve introduced a brand-new tutorial experience to help you master the game’s mechanics:
[list]
[*] Core skills: Jump, Dash, Wall Run, Shoot, Bullet Time, and Melee.
[*] Advanced techniques: Perfect the Dash Bullet Time combo in a dedicated training map!
[/list][/list]
[previewyoutube=QgoXDlMjuJw;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]🌟 Visual Enhancements[/h2]
[list]
[*] A sleek, redesigned main menu with stunning Cyberpunk-inspired visuals for a sharper and more immersive start to your gameplay.
[*] Two new maps, including one featuring the Cyberpunk aesthetic we’ve always envisioned, filled with dynamic visuals.
[*] Enhanced VFX that make every action explode with energy and style.
[/list]
[previewyoutube=zFrTvwr8FSY;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]🎵 Audio Upgrades[/h2]
[list]
[*] Authentic footstep sounds to heighten immersion.
[*] New music tracks to keep the intensity high during matches.
[*] A satisfying typing sound plays as dialogue text appears, adding a delightful touch of personality to every conversation.
[/list]

This is just the beginning! Dive into the latest update, explore the upgrades, and take your skills to the next level. The arena is waiting for you!

notes.title: Major Update 2: Brand New UI, Improved Gameplay, and More!
notes.content:
[h2]🚀 What's New:[/h2]

[h3]🖥️ Complete UI Overhaul[/h3]
[list]
[*] We’ve completely revamped the game’s [b]UI[/b], including menus, in-game HUD, player lists, bump indicators, and even the spectator mode! Everything looks sharper, smoother, and more intuitive, ensuring you stay fully immersed in the action at all times.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048077/d7df8c9e490479d9831b50d95b6fef48bd8c153a.png[/img]

[h3]🏃Enhanced Motion-Matching Animations[/h3]
[list]
[*] Get ready for the most realistic movement you’ve seen in BUMP yet! With Unreal Engine 5's [b]latest motion-matching technology[/b], your character’s running animations have never felt smoother and more lifelike. Every turn, sprint, and movement reacts fluidly in sync with your inputs.
[/list]
[previewyoutube=dJKSmlLoc8A;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]💥 Explosive Gameplay Features[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Shots now explode upon hitting players or terrain, creating a powerful blast that bumps players away![/b] Whether you're chasing down enemies or dodging incoming fire, this update makes every shot feel impactful, and standing still is no longer a safe option!
[*] The [b]dash-bullet time combo[/b] is now easier to pull off, making it more accessible for new players to master, while still offering satisfying mastery for veterans.
[/list]

[h3]🔄 Rounds System + Spectator Mode[/h3]
[list]
[*] We’ve introduced [b]a new rounds system[/b] that automatically calculates the number of rounds based on player count, eliminating players at the end of each round and raising the stakes for every moment.
[*] [b]Spectator Mode[/b] is here! Once you’ve been eliminated, jump into spectator mode and follow the remaining players from different camera angles, or freely float around the map to catch all the action.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45048077/47253199cccb0b2e38163cece325d65dee04c887.png[/img]

[h3]⚡ Performance Optimizations[/h3]
[list]
[*] Performance has been [b]greatly improved[/b], allowing BUMP to run at [b]60+ FPS[/b] even when hosting, on a wide range of systems. No more stuttering or lag — just smooth, uninterrupted fun!
[/list]

This is just the beginning! We're committed to constantly improving BUMP, adding [b]even more features[/b], gameplay modes, and surprises in future updates. Stay tuned for more exciting additions coming your way!

[b]Get back into the game and feel the difference — see you in the arena![/b]
